headline: Palantine Berm Stirs as Stlican and Stonecradle Trade Posts
war_summary: Since the last edition the pace has turned again, with Palantine Berm reporting three changes in the last two hours and forty-eight in the day around Vendett, Windburn Landing and The Pippeli Stones, now holding four Warden and three Colonial posts with the latest wire timed to the hour. Stlican Shelf has quickened to five changes in two hours and eight in the day at Breaker Town and Briar, holding two Warden and seven Colonial posts amid accelerating losses. Stonecradle eases to three changes in two hours and eighteen in the day at The Dais and The Reach, now one Warden and eight Colonial. Weathered Expanse, Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow, Gutter and Farranac Coast have gone quiet in the last two hours after heavy twenty-four-hour tallies of thirty-nine, thirty-one, twenty-nine, fourteen and five, with Expanse now seven Warden and two neutral. Nevish Line is also silent since the evening, while heavy casualties without a flip continue in Clahstra, Callum's Cape, Morgens Crossing and Callahan's Passage.
